comments.body: A delivery item required for this week's Solar Barge, it can be gained in several ways as shown above. I think Knights from the time of the Crusades is the best option since you can deliver the orb in Beirut, and two of the remaining Barge quests this involve the Eastern Mediterranean anyway. To each their own, of course!
